instruction: Candid street photograph, low-angle full shot looking up outdoor stone stairs in a narrow alleyway. On the left, the man in the white suit and white wings (R2) walks down the steps, looking towards his partner. On the right, the woman in the black dress and black wings (R1) walks beside him, looking back at him. The man and the woman hold hands as they descend the staircase together. The scene is illuminated by warm natural daylight, casting soft shadows on the stone steps and warm-toned walls.
